The population $N$ of the excited level decays at the rate $\gamma > 0$ and is pumped, so that
in the rotating frame
\begin{equation}
\frac{d\left(N e^{-\gamma t}\right)}{dt} = \left(\dot N - \gamma N\right) e^{-\gamma t} .
\label{eq:dot1}
\end{equation}
For a chirped pulse the instantaneous frequency is
\begin{equation}
\frac{d(\omega t)}{dt} = \omega + \dot\omega t .
\label{eq:dot2}
\end{equation}
